text:
I've been working with Mr. Fellner for several months. He is very professional, patient, kind, a focused listener. The most I appreciate about him is that it took just couple of sessions to get the positive results and emotional relief.
His emotional intelligence is excellent. His insights have deeply resonated with me and given me a solid foundation on which to stand.
He also made me laugh, which made the therapy's atmosphere very pleasant and relaxing. I would definitely recommend him!
